leakage risk: Only known after the plane leaves the gate; correlation with ARR_DELAY = 0.97
how it is prevented: Never used as a feature of the flight itself (only to build lagged context of OTHER flights)

item: DEP_TIME, WHEELS_OFF, TAXI_OUT, WHEELS_ON, TAXI_IN, ARR_TIME, ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME, AIR_TIME
leakage risk: Realised during or after the flight

how it is prevented: Used only to create the 4 class labels

leakage risk: Could include the flight itself or future flights
how it is prevented: Only flights scheduled >= 3 h earlier are used; the flight is never in its own window

leakage risk: A random split lets the model see the future
Fitting them on all data leaks information
how it is prevented: Fitted on the training set only

leakage risk: Tuning on test data would inflate scores
how it is prevented: Tuned on validation only; test used once at the end
